parties:
State ----- Appellant
vs
Shahidur Rahman alias Shahid ----- Respondent
full_judgment:
AKM Fazlur Rahman J: This is a reference under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure submitted by the learned Judge of the Druta Bichar Tribunal No. 1, Dhaka for confirmation of sentence of death awarded by him to condemned prisoner Shahidur Rahman alias Shahid and absconding accused Kala Jahangir convicting them under sections 302/ 120B of the Penal Code in Druta Bichar Tribunal Case No. 8 of 2002 by the judgment and order dated 29-5-2003. 

 6. The prosecution case, in short, is that deceased Advocate Md Habibur Rahman Mondal alias Habib Mondal was the General Secretary of Sutrapur Thana BNP and the Joint Secretary of the Dhaka District Bar Nationalist Ainjibi Forum. He has bitter enmity and rivalry over local politics with accused Shahidur Rahman alias Shahid, Commissioner of Ward No. 83 of Dhaka City Corporation. The deceased used to reside in a rented flat at 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Street of Bonogram Road of Dhaka City. On 20-8-2000 at about 9.30 AM the deceased on way to Dhaka District Court from his residence by a Vespa motorcycle driven by Arshad alias Asad , the Advocate's clerk attached to him, when reached between Barsha Beauty Parlour and Sujan Hair Dresser, at a little distance of his residence, someone called him as Habib Bhai from the back. At this at the indication of the deceased Arshad made the speed of the motorcycle slow. At that time one of the accused persons shot the deceased. The bullet penetrated into the back of his head and exited through his mouth. Then the same bullet hit on the back of Arshad. The deceased and Arshad fell down with the motorcycle. The accused persons came forward to them. Accused Kachi trampled the chest of the deceased. Accused Kala Jahangir, shot with pistol touching above his left ear causing a perforated bullet injury. Other accused persons making blank shots departed, of whom Arshad recognised Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid and Kala Sharif. The deceased was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital the doctor then declared him dead. Accused Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid made conspiracy of killing the deceased with the other accused persons, in consequence of which the deceased was shot dead. 

 7. On the basis of GD Entry No.1704 dated 20-8-2000 of Ramna Police Station police made inquest of the dead body of the deceased at Dhaka Medical College Hospital and sent the same to the morgue for post mortem examination. After post mortem examination Namaz-e-janaja of the deceased was held in different places and then he was buried. On the same day at 11-25 PM Abdul Hye Bhuiyan, a political associate of the deceased, lodged first information report with Sutrapur Police Station. The Police after investigation of the case submitted final report, against which the informant filed a naraji petition. The learned Magistrate allowed the naraji petition and directed further investigation of the case by CID Accordingly, CID holding further investigation submitted charge sheet against eighteen accused persons. The case was transferred to the Druta Bichar Tribunal No.1, Dhaka, wherein charge under sections 120B/302/307/324/34 of the Penal Code was framed against all the eighteen accused persons, of whom (1) Kachi, (2) Biplab, (3) Shahin, (4) Pichchi Hannan, (5) Tanai Molla, (6) Sentu, (7) Dakat Shahid @ Shahid, (8) Wali Mohammad, (9) Nurul Haq, (10) Kala Jahangir, (11) Opu @ Chakma Opu and (12) Kala Sharif were absconding. The charge was read over to the accused persons on dock, namely, (1) Din Islam @ Dina, (2) Rahman, (3) Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid, (4) Abdul Malek, (5) Alam @ Alamgir and (6) Akhtar Hossain, who pleaded innocence and demanded justice. 

 10. PW 1 Abdul Hye Bhuiyan is the informant. He deposed that he was a resident of Joginagar, while the deceased Habibur Rahman Mandal @ Habib Mandal was a resident of Bonogram Road. He (PW 1) was the Joint Secretary of BNP, Ward No.74 and political associate of the deceased. On 20-8-2000, Sunday, at about 9-30 AM at Bonogram near Barsha Beauty Parlour the deceased was murdered. When he (PW 1) was getting himself ready for going to the Court to appear in a case he got information that the deceased was murdered. He going near Barsha Beauty Parlour found blood and heard that the deceased had already been shifted to the hospital. He informed the incident to Kazi Abul Bashar, Commissioner of Ward No.74. Then he went to Dhaka Medical College Hospital and found the dead body of the deceased. Many people were present there. He further stated that after post mortem examination they taking the dead body of the deceased came to High Court compound. After Namaz-e-janaja of the deceased there the dead body was taken to Dholaikhal, where again Namaz-e-janaja was held. Then the dead body was taken to Dhaka District Bar. After Namaz-e-janaja there the dead body was taken to Mill Barrack at Faridabad within Ward No.82. At the time of occurrence the deceased used to live in a rented house at 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Street of Bonogram Road. The deceased was the General Secretary of BNP, Sutrapur Police Station and the General Secretary of Dhaka District Bar Jatiatabadi Ainjibi Forum. The deceased had conflict and rivalry with accused Shahidur Rahman @ Shahid Commis-sioner. He further stated that on the date of occurrence at 9-00 PM he (PW 1) went to their party central office, where is presence of Sadek Hossain Khoka and Kazi Abdul Bashar the ejahar was written. Therefrom he went to the police station and lodged First Information Report. He proved the First Information Report, Exhibit-1 and his signature therein, Exhibit-1/1. The police submitted final report. He filed a naraji petition. Then further investigation was held by the CID. In the year 2002 he met with Asad, the Muhari (Advocate's clerk) of the deceased, who told him that coming from the residence of the deceased he and the deceased on way to the Court by Vespa motor-cycle driven by him after going 100 yards to the west of the intersection of four roads someone called the deceased as Habib Bhai, from the back, that the deceased placing his hand on his shoulder gave an indication to stop the motor-cycle, that at that time a bullet hit and penetrated into the head of the deceased and exited through his mouth and then hit on his (Asad) back, that the deceased fell down, that a man trampled the chest of the deceased and declared that in sequel of the conflict with Shahid Commissioner the deceased was shot down. Asad also told him that at that time Kala Jahangir shot at the head of the deceased, that accused Kala Jahangir, Kachi, Pichchi Hannan, Chakma Opu, Din Islam, Nurul Haq, Shahin, Akhter, Rahman and others threatened to kill him (Asad) like the deceased if he would give evidence as to the occurrence. This witness further stated that the deceased was the President of BNP Ward No. 82 and also the Chairman of the Development Committee of that ward. In that ward the deceased contested in the election for the post of the Commissioner. At the instance of accused Shahid Commissioner, accused Kala Sharif contested with him and for that the deceased was defeated at a marginal vote. At this the deceased declared that in future he would contest in the election in Ward No.83 with accused Shahid Commissioner. The bitterness between them increased over the murder cases of Michel and Sentu, of which Shahid Commissioner was an accused. Shahid Commissioner understood that it would not be possible for him to remain in politics in presence of the deceased and for that the deceased should be finished. Shahid Commissioner gave money to accused Wali Mohammad for killing the deceased and entrusted Tanai Molla with that work. Thereafter Shahid Commissioner went abroad and the deceased was killed. In cross-examination, this witness stated that deceased Habib Mondal was very much popular in Ward No.74 as a resident of that area by birth. In cross-examination, this witness further stated that he going to the medical college hospital heard from Arshad (PW 8), Milan (PW 7) and Nurul Haq (PW 25) that the dead body of the deceased was lying in the morgue. He could not meet Arshad within 1½ year after the occurrence. He further stated that on the date of occurrence in the medical college hospital he heard the occurrence from Arshad, Nurul Haq and Milan. This witness further stated that on that day none told him who killed the deceased. He further said that on the date of occurrence he went to the hospital at 10-30 and stayed there till 01-00/01-30 PM. He did not state the occurrence of killing the deceased to the leaders of BNP who visited the hospital, as at that time he did not know the occurrence. He did not know whether Arshad appeared before the police in the hospital. He was not present at the time of making inquest of the dead body. None of the vicinity of the place of occurrence disclosed that he had witnessed the occurrence. After his arrival in the BNP Central Office the leaders asked him to be informant of the case. At the time of filing naraji petition on 19-6-2001 Awami League was in power. Before filing naraji petition he did not meet Arshad. He searched for Arshad, but he did not dare to go to Arshad's residence in Ward No.82. He made no GD Entry as to missing of Arshad. He denied the suggestion that subsequently prevailing upon Arshad the accused persons were falsely implicated. He further stated that when BNP came to power he was out of town. He admitted that he did not state in the FIR that the deceased had conflict with accused Shahid Commissioner. He denied the suggestion that Shahid Commissioner had been falsely implicated due to political rivalry. The deceased was the owner of the house of Holding No. 96 of Bonogram. He frankly conceded that he had no direct knowledge about the occurrence. He denied the defence suggestion that in the sequel to conflict amongst local BNP leaders the deceased was assassinated. 

 13. PW 4 Azharul Islam Titu deposed that he was the proprietor of a computer centre at 4/1/D Hare Street, Wari. On 20-8-2000 at 8-30 AM on way to that computer centre from his residence he saw a white microbus standing in front of Silver Deal Preparatory School intervened by 3/4 buildings from his office. At about 8-45/9-00 AM while he was sitting at his office he heard sound of shots. He came out of his office and following the sound of shots proceeded towards Silver Deal Preparatory School and found some people making blank shots. Then those people boarded on the micro-bus. Amongst them he could recognise accused Alamgir, Rahman, Malek and Akhter and later on reading newspaper he could identify accused Kala Jahangir, Pichchi Hannan, Biplab and Sentu. The microbus went towards east. Then proceeding towards west he heard hue and cry. He found Habib Mondal lying beside Barsha Beauty Parlour. Arshad and Nurul Haq lifted Habib Mondal on a rickshaw. He shared with them. Habib Mondal was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. This witness identified accused Alamgir, Malek, Akhter and Rahman on dock and said that he could identify other accused persons if they would have been available on dock. In cross-examination he stated that he had faith on BNP politics. Deceased Habib Mondal by birth was a resident of Ward No. 74. When he came to know that CID took up further investigation of the case he going to the investigating officer of CID gave statement. Before that for want of security he did not give any statement to the police. When BNP came to power and Shahid Commissioner was arrested he became anxiety free. He was a tenant of holding No. 96, Bonogram Road since 1974 or 1975. This holding belonged to the father of Habib Mondal. He had connection with politics, but he was not active. On the date of occurrence at 5-00 PM he met the wife of deceased Habib Mondal in her residence. Before that he was in his place of work. He did not disclose the occurrence to the people present in the hospital. He told the occurrence to his known persons. He denied the suggestions that as he was a tenant of the house of Habib Mondal being influenced by the members of Habib Mondal's family and due to political biasness he deposed falsely or that due to the local political conflicts Habib Mondal was done to death or that he recognised none of the accused persons. 

 17. PW 8 Arshad alias Asad stated that he was attached to deceased Advocate Habibur Rahman Mondal since 1993 as an Advocate's Clerk. In the year 1990 Habib Mondal was elected as the President of BNP of Ward No. 82. In the year 1991 he was selected as the Chairman of the Development Committee of that ward. The popularity of Habib Mondal in that ward increased as he had done many development works. At this accused Shahidur Rahman, Commissioner of Ward No. 83, became jealous. In the year 1994 deceased Habib Mondal contested in the election for the post of Commissioner of Ward No. 82. In that election at the instance of accused Shahid Commissioner accused Kala Sharif contested with Habib Mondal, but he was defeated in that election. After the election in a meeting of the supporters and workers of Habib Mondal told that he was defeated due to Shahid Commissioner. Habib Mondal then declared that in the next election he would contest for the post of the Commissioner of Ward No. 83. requested his workers to be ready for that election. At this Shahid Commissioner became furious against him. In the year 1995 Shahid Commissioner made conspiracy to kill Habib Mondal. In this regard Habib Mondal made a GD entry with Sutrapur Police Station, being GDE No. 9646 dated 29-5-1995. A copy of that GD entry, filed by this witness, was marked as Exhibit-3 with objection. In the year 1996 when Awami League came to power, the house of Habib Mondal was attacked. In that incident his neighbour Helal Uddin was murdered. There was explosion of bombs in his residence and he narrowly escaped. A case was filed against Shahid Commissioner and his men Kachi, Alamgir and others. Police took no step to arrest the accused persons of that case as Awami League was in power. At this Habib Mondal shifted his residence to 53/7 Haricharan Roy Road. In the year 1997 accused Wali Mohammad filed a case being Sutrapur Police Station Case No. 107(4)/1997 against Habib Mondal. In the year 1998 Habib Mondal went into custody. At that time Shahid Commissioner falsely implicated some followers of Habib Mondal in a concocted case. In the year 1998 Habib Mondal married in the area of Ward No. 82. At the behest of Shahid Commissioner a worker of Habib Mondal, namely, Sujan alias Michel was killed. The officer-in-charge of the police station refused to record the case against Shahid Commissioner. The case was recorded in the name of others. FIR was lodged in the name of Shahid Commissioner and others in connection with Sentu murder case. One day in the month of April or May, 2000 (the date could not be remembered), at about 11-00 AM, one Babu alias Teypa Babu came to the chamber of Habib Mondal and informed him that Shahid Commissioner offered him Taka 5,00,000 and arms for killing him (Habib Mondal), but he did not agree. Teypa Babu alerted Habib Mondal as he might be killed by the cohort of Shahid Commissioner. Teypa Babu also advised him to shift his residence from Ward No. 82. In the murder cases of Michel and Sentu final reports were submitted against Shahid Commissioner. On behalf of the informant of those cases Habib Mondal as an Advocate filed naraji petitions, which were rejected. Habib Mondal preferred revisions against those orders of rejection of naraji petitions. Then Habib Mondal rented a flat in the 4th floor of 10/2 Chandra Mohan Basak Street. On the date of occurrence on 20-8-2000 at about 8-30 AM he (PW 8) came to the house of Habib Mondal on a Vespa motorcycle. Habib Mondal came down from his residence at about 09-15/09-30 AM for going to the Court. He (PW 8) sat on the seat of the driver of the vespa and Advocate Habib Mondal took his seat on his back. He started the motor-cycle. After going 25/30 yards west he turned towards the south and after going 10/12 yards ahead, someone from the back called Habib Mondal addressing him Habib Bhai. At this Habib Mondal placing his hand on his shoulder indicating to stop. He made speed of the motor-cycle slow on the road between Barsha Beauty Parlour and Sujan Hair Dresser. At that time a bullet hit on the back of the head of Habib Mondal. He (PW 8) felt pain on his back. The bullet perforating the head of Habib Monal exited through his mouth and hit on his (PW 8) back. He fell down from the motor-cycle and thereafter he stood up. He found accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid, Kala Sharif and 2/3 others coming forward. Accused Kachi trampled the chest of Habib Mondal and Kala Jahangir shot touching a pistol above his left ear. Then many shots were made by the accused persons. The neighbouring people were threatened by fire. Accused Kachi said that in sequel of conflict with Shahid Commissioner Habib Mondal had been taught a good lesson at the behest of Shahid Commissioner. The accused being sure about the death of the deceased told him (PW 8) that he (PW 8) was left alive on consideration that he was a gentle boy of the locality. They threatened him that his condition would be same as of Habib Mondal, if he would disclose the occurrence to anybody and give evidence against them. Thereafter accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi and Biplab marking shots went away towards east and accused Dakat Shahid, Wali Mohammad and Kala Sharif went through Bonogram Road towards south of Tipu Sultan Road. Immediately after the occurrence Manjurul Haq Milan (PW 7), Azharul Islam Titu (PW 4), Nurul Haq (PW 25) and others came to him running. Zakir (PW 3) also came forward with his rickshaw. He and Nurul Haq (PW 25) lifted Habib Mondal on that rickshaw and shifted him upto Gulistan by that rickshaw, wherefrom by scooter they took the deceased to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The doctor on duty in the emergency department after examining Habib Mondal declared him dead. Thereafter he felt pain on the right side of his back. The doctors examining him said that being hit with bullet he received lacerated injury on his back. The bullet was obstructed by the bone. The doctor advised him to be admitted in the hospital, but he did not agree. The injury was dressed by the doctor. He stayed in the hospital for some time. Later on Milan, Titu, Abdul Hye and Bashar came to the hospital. They inquired him about Habib Mondal. He informed them that he died and his dead body was taken to the morgue. Thereafter he went to the Court and informed the incident to the advocate friends of Habib Mondal. Then he went to the residence of Habib Mondal. He stayed there till evening. The dead body was taken there. The wife of Habib Mondal and others saw the dead body. He became sick seeing the dead body. Then he was shifted to National Hospital, where he was admitted. He further said that he being afraid of the killers of Habib Mondal left the hospital executing a bond and stayed in the house of his relation for that night. Next morning he read a report of the Deputy Commissioner, Detective Branch, published in the Daily Dinkal. He did not feel safe to go to the police. He met none. He fled to different places and passed about 1½ year. When BNP came to power Shahid Commissioner was arrested. Police submitted final report. The informant filed a naraji petition. Further investigation was taken up by CID. At this he gained courage. On 18-2-2002 he went to the house of the informant and made statement to the investigating officer. This witness identified accused Malek, Rahman, Alamgir. Akhter and Shahid Commissioner on the dock. In cross-examination he stated that he was enrolled as an Advocate's Clerk in the year 1998. But he started working as a clerk of Habib Mondal from 1994. Before getting 'sanad' (certificate) he worked as an Assistant of Habib Mondal. Before him Habib Mondal had two other assistants named Abu Taher and Hannan. He read up to Class IX. Habib Mondal started politics at Bonogram area. That was his place of birth. He did not continue with the profession of Advocate's clerk after the death of Habib Mondal. He did not file any paper to the investigating officer as to his profession as Advocate's clerk. Those papers were missing with the death of Habib Mondal. In the death certificate of Habib Mondal his (PW 8) name was not mentioned as the person who took Habib Mondal to the hospital. Anwarul Haq (PW 26) was an accused in many murder cases. He met Milan, Azharul Islam, Nurul Haq, Anwarul Islam, Abdul Hye (informant), Kazi Abul Bashar and many others after taking Habib Mondal to the hospital. Those people inquired on how the occurrence took place. But he did not say anything to them. From the hospital he at first went to the Bar Library at 10-15/10-30 AM where he met with many Advocates of BNP. But being afraid of his life he did not speak of the occurrence. He had no discharge certificate for showing that he took treatment at Dhaka Medical College Hospital. He could not remember when he went to National Hospital for treatment. It might be in the afternoon. At about 11-30 AM he arrived in the residence of Habib Mondal, where the dead body of Habib Mondal was brought later on. The relatives of Habib Mondal and BNP leaders came there. But he did not tell them anything about the death of Habib Mondal. He fainted repeatedly. Many rickshaws used to pass through the place of occurrence road, which was 10/11 feet in breadth. There were many shops near the place of occurrence. They started for the hospital taking Habib Mondal within 7/8 minutes of his (Habib) being shot. In the meantime many people assembled in the place of occurrence. The people of the neighbouring shops and houses rushed there. He further stated that he could not say who shifted him (Arshad) to National Hospital. When he remained hidden he had telephonic connection with his mother, brother and sisters. He appeared before the people for the first time on 18-2-2002. Accused Shahidur Rahman was elected Commissioner of Ward No. 83 for sixteen years. He did never contest for the post of Commissioner of Ward No. 82. He contested in the City Corporation election as an independent candidate. After the departure of the accused persons he did not try to flee away. The gap between the first shot and second one to the deceased was one or one and half minute only. He did not meet the wife of the deceased upto 18-2-2002. 

 20. PW 11 Liton stated that on 24-2-2002 at 4-30 PM he went to the house of PW 8 Arshad, where the CID officer came. Arshad gave his blood-stained trousers and shirt to the CID officer. The shirt had a hole on the back. The CID officer seized those trousers and the shirt. This witness identified a shirt, marked as Materials Exhibit-II and a trousers, Material Exhibit-III, as those seized shirt and trousers. He also stated that the CID officer also seized two slips one of National Hospital and another of Dhaka Medical College Hospital under the seizure list, Exhibit-5. He identified his signature as Exhibit-5/1 in the seizure list and those two seized slips, Material Exhibit-IV and IV/a. In cross-examination he stated hat he was an illiterate person. The seized hospital slips were photostat copies. Harunur Rashid Suman, another witness of the seizure list, was the brother-in-law of Arshad (PW 8). 

 23. PW 14 Jagannath Das Khokan stated that as Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka on 4-5-2002 he recorded the statement of witness Aynul Haq (not examined) under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. On 22-5-2002 he recorded the statement of witness Kamal Hossain (PW 2) under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. He proved both the statements, which were marked as exhibits. 

 24. PW 15 Nilufar Yeasmin Diba, the wife of deceased Habib Mondal, stated that after her marriage with the deceased on 17-11-1998 the deceased informed her that Shahid Commissioner's men had been trying to kill him and he might be killed by Shahid Commissioner. In the month of April or May the deceased fled away from his residence at Faridabad with the apprehension of being killed by the men of Shahid Commissioner. He made a GD entry in this regard. Then on 1-6-2000 they started living in a rented flat in the 4th floor of the building at Holding No.10/2 Chandra Mohan Basak Lane, Wari. Her husband told her that Arshad (PW 8) alerted him as he saw Kala Jahangir in the area. She further stated that the deceased passed the previous night of occurrence restless and with tension. In the morning his cousin with her husband came to their house. Her husband left the house for Court with Arshad by a vespa motor-cycle. At that time she was chatting with the cousin of her husband. In the meantime Arshad returned and informed her that the husband was shot. She could not perceive that the bullet hit on his head. She sent Salauddin, husband of the cousin of her husband, to see her husband, who going to the place of occurrence found her husband lying on the ground being hit with bullet. She further said that long after that the Advocates of Dhaka District Bar informed her about the death of her husband. She further stated that she did never see Shahid Commissioner. In cross-examination she stated that the paternal house of her husband was at 10/2 Chandra Mohan Basak Lane. The police interrogated her on the date of occurrence at noon. She also gave statement to the TV channels that she suspected involvement of Arshad (PW 8) as her husband deposited money with him (Arshad). She repeatedly made query to Arshad to know what happened. Arshad said that he had recognised the assailants, but he refused to disclose their names at that moment. For that she suspected Arshad's involvement in shooting her husband to death. She unsuccessfully searched for Arshad and lastly could communicate with him. About 7/8 months after the occurrence Arshad came to her Wari residence. She further stated that the Officer-in-charge of Sutrapur Police Station interrogated her and informant. On the date of occurrence in the evening the informant met her and discussed about the case. She then said that she stated to the informant what she heard from Arshad over telephone. The informant also informed her that he had talk with Arshad. In the month of June, 2002 Munshi Atiqur Rahman, the ASP of CID interrogated her. 

 25. PW 16 ASM Iftekhar Hyder @ Md Sohel stated that on 20-8-2000 he received information that his sister's husband Advocate Habib Mondal was assassinated. He then rushed to the house of the deceased. On 21-8-2000 at 12-45 PM a Vespa motor cycle, numbered Dhaka Metro-La-11-261, by which the deceased was going to the Court at the time of occurrence, was seized under the seizure list. He proved that seizure list, Exhibit-9 and his signature therein marked as Exhibit-9/1. The seized motor-cycle was left in his (PW 16) custody under a jimmanama, Exhibit-10, containing his signature, Exhibit-10/1. In cross-examination he stated that in the seizure list the place of seizure was shown at 10/2 Chandra Mohan Basak Street, Sutrapur, but that was not the place of occurrence. 

 28. PW 19 Dr Kazi Mahbubur Rahman stated that on 20-8-2000, while he was a Lecturer, Forensic Medicine Department of Dhaka Medical College, Constable Delwar Hossain brought the dead body of Advocate Habibur Rahman Mondal aged 45 years to the morgue under a chalan for post mortem examination. He found the following injuries in the dead body. 

 29. PW 20 Shahidul Islam Shahin stated that on 20-8-2000 he was attached to Sutrapur Police Station as Sub-inspector of Police. After recording of the case, at the direction of the officer-in-charge of the police station, he took up investigation of the case. He visited the place of occurrence, prepared sketch map, Exhi-bit-15, with index, Exhibit-16 and recorded the statements of three witnesses under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seized some blood-stained sand, a shell of used cartridge of .32 bore revolver and a part of bullet made of zinc under the seizure list, Exhibit-17. He also seized the deceased's vespa motor-cycle, being numbered Dhaka-Metro-La-11-0261, by which the deceased was going to the Court at the time of occurrence, under the seizure list, Exhibit-9 and left the seized vespa motor-cycle in the custody of Mohammad Hossain, brother-in-law of deceased under a jimmanama, Exhibit-10. He out of suspicion arrested Md Majibur Rahman @ Bachchu Mia. He tried to question Arshad, the Assistant of the deceased, who was accompanying the deceased at the time of occurrence. But he could not record his statement as he was not available. On 31-8-2000 Abdul Hye, the Officer-in-charge of the police station took over investigation of the case and accordingly he (PW 20) handed over the case docket with papers and alamats to him. In cross-examination he stated that on 21-8-2000 at 12-45 PM he seized the vespa motor-cycle of the deceased from Holding No. 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Lane, Sutrapur, Dhaka. In the seizure list it was not mentioned that there was any blood stain on the vespa. He did not make any inquiry who took away the motor-cycle from the place of occurrence to 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Lane and who produced the same before him. He visited the place of occurrence on 21-8-2000 at 8-15 AM. The case was endorsed to him for investigation immediately after recording of the case in the police station at 11-25 PM on 20-8-2000. When he visited the place of occurrence he found the pace bracketed by bricks. The place of occurrence was visible from the shops and houses marked as ‘খ’,‘গ’,‘ঘ’,‘ঙ’,‘জ’,‘ঝ’,‘ঞ’,‘ট’,‘ত’, in the sketch map. He recorded the statements of Abdul Majid, Kashem and Md Awlad Hossain, who did not mention the name of the accused persons. The name of Arshad was mentioned in the First Information Report. During investigation done by him he met the informant at 10/1 Chandra Mohan Basak Lane. He did not go to the house of Arshad @ Asad. He searched for Arshad and notified the informant to producing him (Arshad) to him. But the informant did not produce him. No notice was served directly in the name of Arshad. He could not trace out Arshad. 

 30. PW 21 Abu Hena Mostafa Kamal stated that on 18-9-2000 while he was the officer-in-charge of Sutrapur Police Station. Inspector Abdul Hye, the investigating officer of this case, being transferred made over the case docket to him.  49. Undisputedly on the date, time and place of occurrence as alleged Advocate Habibur Rahman Mondal @ Habib Mondal was shot and he was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital and the doctor declared him dead. PW 24 testified that in Dhaka Medical College Hospital he made inquest of the dead body of the deceased and sent the same to the morgue for post mortem examination through PW 22. The inquest report is Exhibit-18 PW 22 corroborated PW 24 that he escorted the dead body to the morgue for post mortem examination. He added that he handed over the same to PW 19 PW 19 testified that he held autopsy of the dead body of the deceased and found two firearm wounds, one entered on the left temporal region at the upper part of the left ear and another entered over mid occipital region and two exit wounds, corresponding to those two entry wounds, one over right parietal region above right ear and another through the mouth cavity breaking upper and lower four cenral incisors. He opined that those bullet injuries were the cause of death of the deceased. His such evidence as to the cause of death is of unimpeachable character. Thus it is well established that the deceased was shot dead. 

 51. PWs 3, 4, 7, 8 and 25 are the witnesses of the occurrence. PW 8 testified that he was the clerk of the deceased Advocate. On the date of occurrence at 8-30 AM he went to the house of the deceased. The deceased came down from his residence around 9-15 to 9-30 AM for going to the Court. They started for the Court by a Vespa motor-cycle. He (PW 8) sat on driving seat and the deceased sat behind him. After going at a little distance someone from their back called the deceased addressing him as 'Habib Bhai'. At this the deceased touching his (PW 8) shoulder indicated him to stop. Accordingly, he made the speed of the motor-cycle slow. At that time someone shot the deceased. A bullet hit on the back of his head and perforating the head hit on the back of this witness. Both of them fell down. He (PW 8) stood up and found accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Chakma Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab, Wali Mohammad, Dakat Shahid, Kala Sharif and 2/3 others came to them. Accused Kachi pressed the chest of the deceased by his foot and accused Kala Jahangir touching a pistol above the left ear of the deceased shot. Thereafter other accused persons making blank shots threatened the neighbouring people. Accused Kachi said that the deceased was shot at the order of Shahid Commissioner as he exceeded his limitation. The accused persons showing threat forbid him not to give evidence and disclose to anybody what he saw, otherwise his fate would be like the deceased. Then accused Kala Jahangir, Malek, Rahman, Sentu, Opu, Pichchi Hannan, Akhter, Alamgir, Kachi, Biplab decamped to the east making shots and accused Dakat Shahid, Wali Mohammad and Kala Sharif departed towards Tipu Sultan Road. In the meantime PWs 4, 7 and 25 came there running PW 3 also came with his rickshaw. He (PW 8) and PW 25 lifted the deceased on the rickshaw of PW 3 and took him upto Gulistan by that rickshaw and then availing a scooter took him to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The doctor declared the deceased dead. This witness further testified that he did not disclose the occurrence to anybody out of fear of the accused and remained hiding in different places for 1½ year. When BNP came to power, Shahid Commissioner was arrested and CID took up investigation of the case he gained courage. He went to the house of the informant on 18-2-2002 and then gave statement to the investigating officer. Being afraid of the accused persons he kept his lips tightened up.
